synopsis: The booklet describes Canadian mining and workplace requirements as provincial, while the glossary identifies CSA M424 as the relevant national standard [f2251, f15525]. No single Canadian federal collision-avoidance or automatic-braking rule was found; this is a research gap, not confirmation that no applicable requirements exist [f2250, f15526, f2871]. Canadian provincial regulations and CSA M424 were not verified, and the research identified no dedicated off-road automatic-braking coverage or testing requirements for Canada [f2252, f15528, f2813]. Before claiming Canadian compliance, the booklet recommends completing a province-by-province market-release requirements matrix [f2253, f15529].
